subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mike decided to skip work.

options.text: Work is being skipped by Mike.
Work is decided to be skipped by Mike.
The work was decided to be skipped by Mike.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The work was decided to be skipped by Mike.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb is changed to its past participle form (here, "skipped" becomes "skipped").
 
• The subject of the active sentence (here, "Mike") becomes the object of the preposition "by
